messages:
anika: Quick company-wide update: Cascade-Realtime and the new Toolcall RPC streaming API are GA in hosted (us-west-2, eu-west-1) as of this morning. Docs & migration: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/realtime-toolcall. Please skim if you own integrations or support rotations :tada:

rob: Awesome! Any compatibility notes for customers using the older websocket-based realtime?

anika: Short answer: the new RPC streaming is intentionally similar but uses typed JSON frames and supports incremental tool outputs + resumable streams. Legacy websocket endpoints will stay up for 60 days while customers migrate.

pj: Can you share a minimal request/response example we can put in SDK README?

anika: Yep — example request to enable RPC streaming:
```
POST /v1/realtime/generate
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer $KEY
  Accept: text/event-stream
Body:
{ "model":"cascade-realtime-2", "toolcall":"rpc-stream", "stream":true }
```
Stream frames look like SSE-ish `data:` lines with typed payloads, e.g. `data: {"type":"tool_delta","tool":"vector_search","chunk":"..."}`. Full samples in the docs and SDK repo.

kate: What about billing/quota impacts? We need to update billing docs and notify big customers.

anika: Two changes: 1) streamed tokens bill per-token as before, 2) new concurrent stream session quota (`stream_sessions`) to protect nodes. Defaults unchanged; we'll email tenants >100k tokens/mo with suggested quotas. No unexpected billing increases expected for most users.

prod-bot: Release note created: "Cascade-Realtime + Toolcall RPC streaming GA". Changelog entry linked at https://console.redwood.ai/changelog/1803310000.

rob: Ops — can you run a staggered rollout and watch for regressions?

ops-bot: Canary started: us-west-2 at 7% traffic for 2h window, then creeping to 25% if healthy. Monitors: p99_latency, stream_disconnect_rate, tool_error_rate, memory_rss. Alerts to #eng-runtime and #eng-sre.

pj: Any known regressions or gotchas we should warn Support about?

anika: A few:. 1) Very large single-tool payloads (>1MB) may require chunking; 2) corporate proxies that close idle connections may drop long-lived streams — recommend keepalive comments or short heartbeats; 3) resumable streams require clients pass the `x-rw-resume-token` header on reconnects. We'll add troubleshooting steps to the internal playbook.

kate: I'll schedule a support blitz and a customer webinar next Tue 9am PT. Also prepping a short external blurb for marketing.

anika: Marketing blurb draft: "Cascade-Realtime + Toolcall RPC streaming GA — faster incremental tool outputs and resumable streams for robust interactive apps." Feel free to shorten.

rob: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the deprecation timeline and migration checklist in #eng-runtime. :rocket:
